# Functions

```{r}
library(stringi)
library(reticulate)
library(readxl)
library(GSEABase)
library(SiPSiC)
library(ggpubr)
calculatePathwayScores <- function(pathwayToScore, countsMatrix) {
  pathwayName <- pathwayToScore@setName
  message(pathwayName)
  pathwayGenes <- pathwayToScore@geneIds
  pathwayScoresObject <- getPathwayScores(countsMatrix, pathwayGenes)
  suppressWarnings(
    if (is.null(pathwayScoresObject)) {
      return(NA)
    }
  )
  return(pathwayScoresObject$pathwayScores)
}
```

# Data


```{r}
# Load data
lung = readRDS(params$input_data["lung"])
lung_patients = lung$patient.ident %>% unique() %>% as.character()
lung_patients_filtered = lung_patients[!(lung_patients %in% c("X1055new","X1099"))] # remove patients with less than 100 malignant cells
lung = subset(x = lung,subset = patient.ident %in% lung_patients_filtered)

#read Kurppa_PMC7146079_table_s1_YAP signature.xlsx tab "Zhang et al. Cancer Res 2008"
kurppa <- readxl::read_excel(params$input_data["kurppa"],sheet = "Zhang et al. Cancer Res 2008")
kurppa_genes <- kurppa[-1,1,drop=T] # remove first row
 
#read Hadrek_PMC11068778_sup_data_3.xlsx tab "Supp. Data 3" 
hadrek <- readxl::read_excel(params$input_data["hadrek"],sheet = "Supp. Data 3",skip = 3)
hadrek_genes <- hadrek[,1,drop = T]

#read FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP.v2024.1.Hs.gmt
FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP  = getGmt(params$input_data["SENESCENCE"]) %>% geneIds() %>%  unlist() %>% base::unname()

# read Avelolar Signature from Maynard_PMC7484178_Table_S2.csv
maynard <- read_csv(params$input_data["maynard"])
maynard_genes <- maynard$`Avelolar Signature` %>% unlist() %>% base::unname()


#read ferroptosis
ferroptosis = getGmt(params$input_data["ferroptosis"]) %>% geneIds() %>%  unlist() %>% base::unname()

# read esrra, remove first row and NA
esrra_up = readxl::read_excel(params$input_data["esrra"],sheet = "Sheet1")[["Up genes"]] %>% .[-1] %>% .[!is.na(.)]
esrra_down = readxl::read_excel(params$input_data["esrra"],sheet = "Sheet1")[["Down genes"]] %>% .[-1] %>% .[!is.na(.)]

# read HIF targets
hif_targets = scan(params$input_data["hif_targets"], character(), quote = "")

# list of all genesets
genesets <- GeneSetCollection(
  GeneSet(kurppa_genes, setName = "Kurppa_YAP"),
   GeneSet(hadrek_genes, setName = "Hadrek_YAP5SA_UP"),
  GeneSet(FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP, setName = "FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP"),
  GeneSet(maynard_genes, setName = "Maynard_Avelolar_Signature"),
  GeneSet(ferroptosis, setName = "Ferroptosis"),
  GeneSet(esrra_up, setName = "ESRRA_UP"),
  GeneSet(esrra_down, setName = "ESRRA_DOWN")

) 

```

```{r}
pathwayScoreLists <- lapply(X = genesets@.Data, calculatePathwayScores, lung@assays$RNA@data %>% expm1())
names(pathwayScoreLists) = names(genesets)
pathwayScoreLists <- pathwayScoreLists[!is.na(pathwayScoreLists)] #remove NA pathways
pathwayScoresMatrix <- as.data.frame(do.call("rbind", pathwayScoreLists))
```


# DE pathways


```{r}
pathwayScoresMatrix = pathwayScoresMatrix %>% rbind(FetchData(lung, vars = c("SUSD2","CAV1"),slot = "data") %>% t())
lung[["known_pathways"]] = CreateAssayObject(counts = pathwayScoresMatrix)

```

```{r}
trace(Seurat:::FindMarkers.default,edit = T) #replace "bonferroni" with "fdr"

```

```{r}
lung = SetIdent(lung, value = "time.point")
pathways_names = gsub(rownames(pathwayScoresMatrix), pattern = "_", replacement = "-")


logFC_df = data.frame(row.names = pathways_names)
fdr_df = data.frame(row.names = pathways_names)

for (patient in unique(lung$patient.ident)) {
  patient_data = subset(lung, subset = patient.ident == patient)
  pathway_markers = FindMarkers(
    object = patient_data,
    ident.1 = "on-lung",
    ident.2 = "pre-lung",
    assay = "known_pathways",
    slot = "counts",
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    densify = T,
    pseudocount.use = 0.001,
    features = pathways_names
  )
  avg_log2FC = pathway_markers[pathways_names, "avg_log2FC", drop = F]
  colnames(avg_log2FC) = patient
  pathway_markers  %<>%  dplyr::rename(fdr = p_val_adj)
  fdr = pathway_markers[pathways_names, "fdr", drop = F]
  colnames(fdr) = patient
  
  logFC_df = cbind(logFC_df, avg_log2FC)
  fdr_df = cbind(fdr_df, fdr)
}
fdr_df_raw = fdr_df
fdr_df = apply(fdr_df, 1:2, \(x) format(x, digits=1)) %>% as.data.frame() #round p values 
fdr_df[fdr_df == 0] = paste0("<",format(.Machine$double.xmin,digits = 1)) # replace p=0 with p<min float
```
```{r}
untrace(Seurat:::FindMarkers.default)

```



```{r}
# color row name if consistent across patients/models
colors= c()
for (row_num in 1:nrow(logFC_df)) {
  row = logFC_df[row_num,]
  if (sum(row > 0.15)  >= 4) { # if at least x values are more than 0.1 log2FC
    colors <- c(colors, "red")
  }
  else if (sum(row < -0.15)  >= 4) {
    colors <- c(colors, "blue")
  }
  else{colors <- c(colors, "black")}
}

```

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
```

## Genes
```{r}
esrra_up = genesets[["ESRRA_UP"]]@geneIds[genesets[["ESRRA_UP"]]@geneIds %in% rownames(lung@assays$RNA@data)]
esrra_down = genesets[["ESRRA_DOWN"]]@geneIds[genesets[["ESRRA_DOWN"]]@geneIds %in% rownames(lung@assays$RNA@data)]

esrra_genes = c(esrra_up,esrra_down) 

lung = SetIdent(object = lung,value = "time.point")

all_logFC_df = data.frame(row.names = esrra_genes)
all_fdr_df = data.frame(row.names = esrra_genes)

for (patient in unique(lung$patient.ident)) {
  model_data = subset(lung, subset = patient.ident == patient)
  deg_df = FindMarkers(
    object = model_data,
    assay = "RNA",
    ident.1 = "pre-treatment",
    ident.2 = "on-treatment",
    densify = T,
    mean.fxn = function(x) {
      return(log(x = rowMeans(x = x) + 1, base = 2))
    },
    features = esrra_genes,
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0,
    test.use = "wilcox",
  )
  deg_df$fdr = p.adjust(deg_df$p_val, method = "fdr", n = length(esrra_genes))
  avg_log2FC = deg_df[, "avg_log2FC", drop = F]
  colnames(avg_log2FC) = patient
  fdr = deg_df[, "fdr", drop = F]
  colnames(fdr) = patient
  all_logFC_df = cbind(all_logFC_df, avg_log2FC)
  all_fdr_df = cbind(all_fdr_df, fdr)
  
}
all_fdr_df[all_fdr_df > 0.05]  = 1 #remove non significant values

all_fdr_df = apply(all_fdr_df, 1:2, \(x) format(x, digits=1)) %>% as.data.frame() #round p values 
all_fdr_df[all_fdr_df == "1"] = ""

all_fdr_df[all_fdr_df == "0"] = paste0("<",format(.Machine$double.xmin,digits = 1))
# replace p=0 with p<min float
```

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
library(grid)
genes_origin = c(rep("ESRRA_UP", length(esrra_up)),
                                    rep("ESRRA_DOWN",  length(esrra_down)))
row_anon = rowAnnotation(pathway = genes_origin,
                         col = list(pathway = c("ESRRA_UP" = "red", "ESRRA_DOWN" = "blue")))
col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1.5, 0, 1.5), c("blue", "white","red"))
p = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(all_logFC_df,  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), 
                            clustering_method_rows = "average", clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                            show_heatmap_legend = T,
                            col = col_fun,
                            name = "log2(FC) on/pre",

                            cluster_row_slices = F,
                            row_title = "ESRRA genes",
                            column_title = "Patients",
                            right_annotation = row_anon,
                            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                              grid.text(all_fdr_df[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
                              })
p
```

## violin plots
```{r}
lung = AddMetaData(object = lung, metadata = as.data.frame(t(pathwayScoresMatrix[c("ESRRA_UP","ESRRA_DOWN"),])))

all_plots = list()
#esrra up
library(rstatix)
for (pathway in c("ESRRA_UP","ESRRA_DOWN")) {
  genes_by_tp = FetchData(object = lung,vars = c("time.point", pathway,"patient.ident"),slot = "data") %>% filter(time.point != "resistant")
  
  # all cells by patient boxplot
  formula <- as.formula(paste0(pathway," ~ time.point"))
  
  #plot and split by patient:
  stat.test <- genes_by_tp %>%
    group_by(patient.ident) %>%
    wilcox_test(formula) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "time.point") %>%
    mutate(p.adj = signif(p.adj, digits = 2))
  stat.test
  
  
  plt = ggplot(genes_by_tp, aes(x = time.point, y = .data[[pathway]])) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width",aes(fill = time.point),trim = T) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "{p.adj}")  + #add p value
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    labs(title = paste(pathway, "per cell"), y = pathway, fill = "time.point")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),axis.title.x = element_blank()) + theme_minimal()+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) + # Add 10% spaces between the p-value labels and the plot border
    facet_wrap(~patient.ident,scales = "free")
  print(plt)

  all_plots[[pathway]] = plt
}


pdf(paste0(params$data_out_dir,"ESRRA_UP_violin_patients.pdf"),width = 10,height = 5)
all_plots[["ESRRA_UP"]]
dev.off()


pdf(paste0(params$data_out_dir,"ESRRA_DOWN_violin_patients.pdf"),width = 10,height = 5)
all_plots[["ESRRA_DOWN"]]
dev.off()
```
